variants.specifics: Brackenford: A townsman points the player to Halvard in the Moot Hall, who sends him after Red Corwin in the watchtower on Crow Hill and hands over the north gate key.

herald.speaker: Townsman
herald.text: Find Halvard in the Moot Hall and send Corwin packing!

opening.speaker: Halvard
opening.text:
Sorry about the crowd, lad, but half the north road has fled in here since Red Corwin took the old watchtower. His bandits watch Crow Hill day and night and rob anyone on the road.

You must drive Corwin out of that tower, and he won't go quietly. It could come to blood. Here is the key to the north gate.

reminder.speaker: Halvard
reminder.text: Keep that key safe, the north gate is locked to everyone else. Corwin's men will see you coming up the hill, so stay off the road. Good luck to you.

journal.text: Drive Red Corwin from the watchtower on Crow Hill.

variants.specifics: Khelm: Haddrick drives the player's cart to the edge of Khelm and sends him to Foreman Orvek, as Gorrak's Trolls raid the mountain road; Mirra points the way.

herald.speaker: Mirra
herald.text: Hello Newcomer! Come find me after Foreman Orvek makes you a Master Miner.

opening.speaker: Haddrick
opening.text:
This is where my cart stops, lad. The deeper we roll toward Khelm, the more Trolls come sniffing.

Walk the ore track the rest of the way down.

Ask after Foreman Orvek. He's an old friend and he'll do what he can for you.

Here, this sword is yours. Any Troll who tries you will feel its edge. Mind your step on the way down.

reminder.speaker: Haddrick
reminder.text: What, still here? Off with you. Down the track!

journal.text: Find Foreman Orvek at the Great Lift in Khelm.

variants.specifics: Kesh: Pell points the player to Mayor Ottrick in the Stilt Hall, who sends him to drive Skarn's Trolls off the Long Causeway from their camp on Gallow Mound.

herald.speaker: Pell
herald.text: The boatmen will wait at the landing, but you must go and see Mayor Ottrick in the Stilt Hall. Glad you came, brave Adventurer!

opening.speaker: Mayor Ottrick
opening.text:
Blast! What kept you so long, lad!? Skarn's Trolls came up out of the reeds, and Kesh would have burned if Tavlin's boatmen hadn't rowed in with torches at the very end!

But while we fought them off the walkways, the brutes seized the Long Causeway, which makes mending our roofs the least of our troubles! Every hamlet in the fen will starve if the Causeway is lost!

You must go where they carried off their wounded, south to Skarn's camp on Gallow Mound! Drive Skarn out or Kesh is finished!

reminder.speaker: Mayor Ottrick
reminder.text: Skarn means to keep that Causeway for good, I'm sure of it! Off with you!

journal.text: Go to Gallow Mound and drive Skarn from the Long Causeway.

variants.specifics: Castle Vorne: Commander Dorvik sends the player to the Ogre watchtower on Blackstone Rise to take back the Horn of Vorne.

herald.speaker: Venn
herald.text: Chin up, stranger, Commander Dorvik will have those Ogres running from our walls!

opening.speaker: Commander Dorvik
opening.text:
So you're Galdric's friend! Welcome to Castle Vorne! We hoped you would come!

Last night Grashnak's Ogres climbed our north wall and made off with the Horn of Vorne! They grow bolder every day! A scout of mine went after the brutes and is still missing.

The Ogres hold the old watchtower on Blackstone Rise, north of the castle. Bring back the Horn, then come to me in the great hall of the Keep.

reminder.speaker: Commander Dorvik
reminder.text: Still no Horn? Those Ogres won't wait for us.

journal.text: Take back the Horn of Vorne from Grashnak's Ogres.

variants.specifics: Varn: Marra points the player to Mayor Ostrin, who sends him against Vosker's pirates at the lighthouse on Gull Rock.

herald.speaker: Marra
herald.text: So you're the one Odwald sent to deal with those filthy pirates! Go and see Mayor Ostrin, stranger!

opening.speaker: Mayor Ostrin
opening.text:
Ah, there you are, lad! Welcome to Varn, proudest fishing village on the Great Lake and home of the finest boatmen in all of Nox!

Row past the pirate boats and take back the old lighthouse on Gull Rock. Then the fight of your life awaits -- Vosker himself, who has drowned better men than you.

reminder.speaker: Mayor Ostrin
reminder.text: Off to the pirates with you, lad!

journal.text: Find a way out to the lighthouse on Gull Rock.

variants.specifics: Quorra: Orlo points the player to Archmage Thule in the Amber Tower, who sends him after Malgrith in the Ossuary.

herald.speaker: Orlo
herald.text: I thought heroes never needed directions. Try Archmage Thule at the top of the Amber Tower.

opening.speaker: Archmage Thule
opening.text:
Ah, lad, you've come -- and to Quorra in its darkest hour. The Amber Tower can do no more for itself.

Past the north gate lies the old Ossuary, where Malgrith, once a Master of this college, has woken the Undead. She knows you are coming. I must hold the wards here, and you must go at once!

Quorra has no one else.

journal.text: Seek out Malgrith, the outcast Master, in the old Ossuary.

variants.specifics: Fort Skarrow: Dobbe points the player to Warden Brolth, who sends him up to the Northgate to learn whether Grakkus leads the Trolls himself.

herald.speaker: Dobbe
herald.text: No, Warden Brolth won't rest while the Trolls sit on the Northgate!

opening.speaker: Warden Brolth
opening.text: Find out whether Grakkus himself is up on the Northgate. If he is, you'll smell him before you see him! The stair behind the barracks takes you there, but watch your step, because the Trolls have rigged it with rockfalls.

reminder.speaker: Warden Brolth
reminder.text: Up to the Northgate, lad! We have to know whether Grakkus leads them himself. Go! Climb the stair and find out if the shaman's up there.

journal.text: Climb to the Northgate and look for signs of Grakkus.

variants.specifics: Vulkir: Ostrid points the player to Forgemaster Odrik, who sends him with the Ember Blade to the Keepers of the Anvil in the Old Kiln.

herald.speaker: Ostrid
herald.text: I've heard Forgemaster Odrik is waiting on some stranger Kessick sent him. Odd times we're living in.

opening.speaker: Odrik
opening.text:
Ah, Kessick's friend. Odrik, Forgemaster to the smiths of Vulkir. At last my Ember Blade is ready to meet the Ember Witch! Only the Keepers of the Anvil can bless it, and they keep to the Old Kiln.

This key will open the iron gate on the mountain road. Take the blade to the kiln and talk with the Keepers.

reminder.speaker: Odrik
reminder.text:
Malgrith has to be beaten! It's YOU who holds the blade that can finish her!

Off you go! There's no time to lose.

journal.text: Find the Keepers of the Anvil in the Old Kiln.

variants.specifics: Pellamar: Tobb points the player to Mayor Corvane in the Town Hall, who sends him north to Thornspur Fort to face Hurgg and his Ogres.

herald.speaker: Tobb
herald.text: Hurgg must have tamed the wolves of the hills! The fort was quiet one night, and by morning Ogres and wolves were crawling all over it. Mayor Corvane wants to see you.

opening.speaker: Mayor Corvane
opening.text:
Dark days have come upon the crossroads. Hurgg, chief of the Ogres, holds Thornspur Fort, and his brutes plunder every caravan on the north road.

You must go up there and face him.

Here are potions and some gold -- buy whatever else you need at Gubbo's cart, then hurry. The road north over the hill leads straight to the fort.

reminder.speaker: Mayor Corvane
reminder.text: There is no more to say, kind sir. Go on up to the fort and deal with Hurgg!

journal.text: Go north from Pellamar to Thornspur Fort and defeat Hurgg.

variants.specifics: Wendrel: A townsman sends the player to Mayor Dunstrel, who sends him to take back the watchtower on Ketter Hill from Grumvak's Ogres.

herald.speaker: Townsman
herald.text: Mayor Dunstrel just ran off to the Town Hall shouting for you!

opening.speaker: Dunstrel
opening.text:
Orvane tells me the road here put you to the test, lad. Well, there's no rest to be had in Wendrel. The Ogres have seized the old watchtower on Ketter Hill, and with it the only road north out of the valley!

With the tower in their claws and our harvest at their mercy, Grumvak the Ogre Lord must be the one giving the orders. Bortle and the farmhands wait for you at the north gate. Go, and be quick!

reminder.speaker: Dunstrel
reminder.text: Off to the north gate with you! Bortle is expecting you there.

journal.text: Take back the watchtower on Ketter Hill from the Ogres.
